commits.author: StanGirard
commits.subject: feat(agent): add auto-update system for version sync with web
commits.body:
When the web frontend connects to the agent via WebSocket, it sends its
version. If the agent version is older, the agent triggers an auto-update
(npm install) and restarts via launchd/systemctl.

Changes:
- Add version.ts module with semver comparison utilities
- Add updater.ts module for auto-update logic with bash script
- Modify websocket-handlers.ts to check versions on connection
- Update server.ts to pass URL to status handler
- Add version-info and update-pending message types to shared
- Inject NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION at build time in next.config.js
- Send version in WebSocket URL from SessionPollingContext
- Handle new message types in web frontend
- Add release scripts for semantic versioning

Tests:
- Unit tests for version comparison (15 tests)
- Unit tests for updater module (12 tests)
- Integration tests for WebSocket version check (9 tests)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

+
+Web terminal access to Claude Code from anywhere.
+
+## Quick Start
+
+```bash
+pnpm install
+pnpm dev
+```
+
+## Architecture
+
+- **apps/web** - Next.js dashboard (Vercel)
+- **apps/agent** - Local Node.js agent with WebSocket terminal
+- **packages/cli** - CLI tool for agent management
+- **packages/shared** - Shared TypeScript types

+name: Deploy Web to Vercel
+
+on:
+  push:
+    tags:
+      - 'v*'
+
+env:
+  VERCEL_ORG_ID: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }}
+  VERCEL_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID }}
+
+jobs:
+  deploy:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Install Vercel CLI
+        run: npm install -g vercel@latest
+
+      - name: Pull Vercel Environment
+        run: vercel pull --yes --environment=production --token=${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
+
+      - name: Build Project
+        run: vercel build --prod --token=${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
+
+      - name: Deploy to Production
+        run: vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod --token=${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
